title: FitVariantAssociationMessage
description: Inbound Fit variant-association message from catalog_inbound_variantassociations.

from_Class.description: Source product id used for Product-level Fit association docs

associationType.description: Association type from source; processor stores type as Fit

to_ProductCode.description: Target variant id stored on Variant-level associations

to_Class.description: Target product id stored on Product-level associations

_DeltaStatus.description: Delta patch against existing associations. DELETED removes the target; any other value (including NEW/UPDATE) adds the target if missing. Unmentioned existing targets are left untouched
